facts.text: GymFxEnv is a Gymnasium Env subclass
reset(seed=..., options=...) returns the first observation and info
step(action) returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info)
The default action space is Discrete(3): 0 is hold, 1 is long and 2 is short
A config can select a continuous Box(-1, +1) action with a threshold (0.33 by default)
The continuous action maps a value at or above the threshold to long, a value at or below its negative to short and a value between them to hold
The default observation contract is a Dict of prices and returns windows plus one-element position, equity_norm, unrealized_pnl_norm and steps_remaining_norm blocks
The default preprocessor pads the price window with its first price until window_size bars exist and sets the first return to zero
The default preprocessor normalizes equity and unrealized PnL by initial_cash and steps remaining by total_bars
reset(seed) reseeds the environment's numpy generator when a seed is given and restarts the backtrader bridge; options are accepted but not used by GymFxEnv.reset
step's truncated flag is always false, and terminated is true when the bridge has terminated or, in normal_realistic solvency mode, equity is at or below min_equity
initial_cash defaults to 10000.0 and min_equity defaults to one percent of initial_cash; both are config overrides
The timeframe comes from the config; with no timeframe the env reports 0 hours, so a bar has no fixed wall-clock duration
build_environment returns GymFxEnv when simulation_engine is backtrader (the default)
The default data feed and broker are offline simulations over CSV files with no network access and no live-trading path

determinism.notes: reset(seed=...) reseeds GymFxEnv's numpy generator (app/env.py:311-314); the fake reseeds Python's random.Random from the same seed, so its synthetic price series repeats for one seed.  The fake and upstream do not share a random stream, so one seed does not replay the same trajectory on both.

gaps: no dynamics are modelled: prices are an analytic placeholder random walk, positions change directly from the action, and no order book, fill, commission, slippage, margin, stop-loss, take-profit or solvency accounting runs (the upstream wraps a backtrader Cerebro, app/env.py:4-6)
the reward is a synthetic equity delta ((new_equity - prev_equity) / initial_cash), not the configured reward plugin of the upstream

the fake covers only the default discrete action space and the default six-block observation; continuous actions, feature_columns, stage_b force-close, OANDA calendar and execution-cost observation blocks are not modelled
no wall-clock pacing and no fixed timestep: timestep_ms is 0 because a bar has no fixed duration (app/env.py:666-684), and each step advances one synthetic bar
the fake terminates at the end of its synthetic series and does not implement the upstream's min_equity termination rule; truncated is always false
snapshot and restore are not offered: GymFxEnv declares no get_state/set_state, and the fake declares none either
the fake was not compared with an upstream run and no upstream package was imported or executed

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step, reset or seed is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the runtime latch, and the last observation stays readable
